Inner Network SMS Terms

Effective Date: November 10, 2026 · Last updated: November 10, 2026 · Version 2026-11-10

1. What these texts are

Inner Network event texts are invitations and reminders for events hosted by Inner Network members. They are sent by Inner Network on behalf of the host named in each text.

2. Who gets them

An invitation text goes only to an invited guest who does not have an Inner Network profile, after the host confirms the guest agreed to hear from them. Reminder texts go only to guests who asked for them on an event page. How often you get texts depends on the event.

3. Stopping texts

Reply STOP (or STOPALL, UNSUBSCRIBE, CANCEL, END, or QUIT) to any text to stop all Inner Network texts to your number, for every host. Reply START to receive them again. Reply HELP for help, or email contact@innernetwork.app.

4. Costs and carriers

Message and data rates may apply. Carriers are not responsible for delayed or undelivered messages.

5. Privacy

We do not use phone numbers for advertising and do not sell or share text consent. See our Privacy Policy at innernetwork.app/privacy-policy.html.
